title: Asymptotically equal blow-up integrals give equal approximate tangent spaces (Simon Ch. 3, Definition 1.4)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let M, M' ⊆ ℝ^P be arbitrary sets and x ∈ ℝ^P. Write η_r = blowUpMap x r and μ = μHE[n]. Suppose that for every compactly supported continuous f : ℝ^P → ℝ, ∫_{η_r(M)} f dμ − ∫_{η_r(M')} f dμ → 0 as r → 0⁺ (filter 𝓝[>]0). Then for every linear subspace Q of ℝ^P, M has approximate tangent space Q at x (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q, Simon Ch. 3, Definition 1.4) if and only if M' does.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M M' : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P), (∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap (Euclid P) ℝ, Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (∫ y in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' M, f y ∂μHE[n]) - ∫ y in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' M', f y ∂μHE[n]) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)) → ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q
